thread:
Elena (CS): Heads-up — Parallax Labs just pushed a big onboarding wave. Saw 3 new workspaces created this morning and token usage spiked ~4x in the last 6 hours. Possible expansion across data, product, and support teams.
Raj (AE): Nice — do we have concrete numbers? which routes are spiking?
Elena (CS): Quick snapshot from console: overall tokens +380%, embeddings calls +520%, chat/generation +220%. Most volume from /v1/embeddings and a few long-context summarization jobs. Link: https://console.redwood.example/parallax/metrics (internal)
Marco (Solutions): Pinged them earlier about streaming vs batch for huge summarization jobs. They confirmed new nightly backfill jobs + interactive summarize for CS. Latency for the interactive paths is ~280ms p50, p95 ~1.2s on hosted tier.
Tessa (SE): 280ms p50 isn't terrible but p95 ok — if they go multi-team we should recommend Dedicated pilot. Also enable prefix KV cache for their summarize pipeline to cut tokens.
Elena (CS): Agreed. Also spotted a comment in their workspace: "need per-route cost breakdown" and "more visibility into embed unit pricing per project" — capturing feedback.
Liam (Customer): @Elena (CS) yes — our finance folks want a per-team cost view before we expand. Also seeing some failed jobs from large sequences (~>16k tokens) — can you advise?
Marco (Solutions): @Liam (Customer) we can suggest 8k quantized model + chunked summarization + cache. I'll draft a config sample.
Elena (CS): Action items: 1) Offer a short Dedicated pilot proposal (Raj) 2) Solutions config + sample pipeline (Marco) 3) Enable cost-breakdown dashboard for their org (Tessa / CS Ops) 4) Schedule enablement call this week.
Raj (AE): I'll prepare a 30-day pilot SKU and estimate. Do we have an upsell motion + renewal timeline? Their annual renewal is in ~90 days. This expansion could increase ARR but also raises renewal risk if cost visibility isn't solved.
Tessa (SE): For cost dashboard, CS Ops can add per-workspace tags and export to billing. @Elena (CS) can you share the exact workspace IDs?
Elena (CS): Workspaces: parallax-data, parallax-cs, parallax-product. I'll DM IDs.
OnboardingBot: Workspace created — parallax-data (owner: liam@parallaxlabs.com) — created 2026-03-20T08:12:03Z
Product Feedback Bot: New request logged — "per-route cost breakdown" (ticket #CS-4921).
Marco (Solutions): Draft config snippet I'm proposing (will paste in doc):
```
# suggested pipeline
- chunk size: 4k tokens
- use_prefix_cache: true
- model: redwood-8k-quant
- embeddings_batch_size: 256
```
Tessa (SE): Also recommend canary routing: keep hosted default but route 10% of requests to Dedicated pilot to validate latency/cost. We should capture traffic patterns (seq length distribution) during pilot.
Liam (Customer): Thanks — can we get that pilot ASAP? Our Q2 launch depends on this.
Raj (AE): I'll send pilot contract + kickoff invite. Proposed kickoff Fri 10am PT. Ok for everyone?
Elena (CS): Friday works. Will prepare onboarding checklist and a short playbook for their engineers.
Marco (Solutions): I'll add sample metrics dashboard and a prom query to track seq length percentiles.
Tessa (SE): I'll scope the cost dashboard work — estimate ~2 days to enable per-workspace breakdown and tags.
Elena (CS): Noting renewal-watch: put Parallax on green->amber if finance isn't satisfied after pilot. Raj, please update renewal risk after pilot.
Raj (AE): Will do. Also capturing feedback request: Product wants more granular embed pricing options — tagging Product team.
Product Feedback Bot: Feature request filed to product backlog with metadata: customer=Parallax Labs, impact=high, area=billing/observability.
Elena (CS): Great. TL;DR: expansion signal confirmed (3 new teams), immediate pilot recommended, cost visibility is top ask, renewal in 90d -> monitor. Scheduling call and assigning owners. :thumbsup:
Raj (AE): Thanks team — I'll loop in legal and finance for pilot pricing.
Liam (Customer): Appreciate it. Looking forward to Friday.
Elena (CS): Closing the loop here — I'll post the invite and attach the playbook.
